Disconnection Actions

Structure

From the disconnection document, you can display the reference object logged within the document, go to the data hierarchy of
the object or change it.

In the disconnection document all the created disconnection and reconnection orders, as well as entry transactions for
disconnection and reconnection are logged as disconnection actions. From the disconnection document you can access the
service orders and disconnection data.

All the devices contained in the disconnection document are logged in the document as disconnection objects. You can display the
material serial numbers of all the devices. The disconnection is based on the device. Flat-rate installations can also be
disconnected.
